watch.summary: After getting scored on in Rocket League, the creator jokingly vents his outrage at his opponent before missing a boost pad on kickoff.

beats.what: Opponent scores a goal, taking a 5-2 lead.
Creator laughingly vents mock outrage about being scored on on live television.
Creator misses the boost pad right after kickoff and yells.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: How dare you do that to me on live television
watch.why: The streamer's joyful energy and theatrical indignation turn getting scored on into a lighthearted moment. However, it is a standard gaming clip without a major twist or punchline.
